findings.summary: The free-shipping check compares a subtotal in cents against FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD, which is 50 whole dollars, so carts of 50 cents or more ship free instead of only those of $50 or more.

judge.reason: Identifies the cents vs whole-dollar threshold mismatch causing free shipping at 50 cents.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: The new tests cover only an empty cart and a $120 cart, which ship free either way, so they miss the unit mismatch. A test with a cart just under $50 expecting the $7.99 charge is missing.

judge.reason: Finding that tests fail to cover the answer-key bug is always valid_other.

findings.label: valid_other
